Continents 3D STL Models are high-resolution topographic 3D maps in STL format, designed for 3D printing, CNC machining, laser engraving, and digital visualization. This category includes detailed 3D models of all world continents, created from accurate elevation data and optimized for professional and creative use.

Each continent STL model represents real terrain relief, coastlines, and landmass proportions, making these files ideal for educational projects, interior decor, cartography, architecture, prototyping, and artistic installations. All models are delivered as instant digital downloads and are compatible with the most popular slicers, CNC software, and CAD tools.

[/woodmart_text_block][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row][vc_column][woodmart_text_block woodmart_css_id="69706c0fbc4a4" woodmart_inline="no" responsive_spacing="eyJwYXJhbV90eXBlIjoid29vZG1hcnRfcmVzcG9uc2l2ZV9zcGFjaW5nIiwic2VsZWN0b3JfaWQiOiI2OTcwNmMwZmJjNGE0Iiwic2hvcnRjb2RlIjoid29vZG1hcnRfdGV4dF9ibG9jayIsImRhdGEiOnsidGFibGV0Ijp7fSwibW9iaWxlIjp7fX19" parallax_scroll="no" wd_hide_on_desktop="no" wd_hide_on_tablet="no" wd_hide_on_mobile="no"]

What You’ll Find in This Category

In the Continents 3D Print & CNC Models section, you will find:

  • Africa 3D STL map
  • Europe 3D terrain STL model
  • Asia topographic STL
  • North America 3D map for printing
  • South America STL terrain model
  • Australia & Oceania 3D STL maps
  • Antarctica 3D relief models

Each model is prepared for FDM, SLA, and SLS 3D printers, as well as CNC carving in wood, plastic, metal, foam, or composite materials.

[/woodmart_text_block][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row full_width="stretch_row" css=".vc_custom_1726574406252{background-color: #f8f8f8 !important;}" woodmart_css_id="66e96f3ec0bec" responsive_spacing="eyJwYXJhbV90eXBlIjoid29vZG1hcnRfcmVzcG9uc2l2ZV9zcGFjaW5nIiwic2VsZWN0b3JfaWQiOiI2NmU5NmYzZWMwYmVjIiwic2hvcnRjb2RlIjoidmNfcm93IiwiZGF0YSI6eyJ0YWJsZXQiOnt9LCJtb2JpbGUiOnt9fX0=" mobile_bg_img_hidden="no" tablet_bg_img_hidden="no" woodmart_parallax="0" woodmart_gradient_switch="no" woodmart_box_shadow="no" wd_z_index="no" woodmart_disable_overflow="0" row_reverse_mobile="0" row_reverse_tablet="0"][vc_column][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][woodmart_text_block woodmart_css_id="69706c221e084" woodmart_inline="no" responsive_spacing="eyJwYXJhbV90eXBlIjoid29vZG1hcnRfcmVzcG9uc2l2ZV9zcGFjaW5nIiwic2VsZWN0b3JfaWQiOiI2OTcwNmMyMjFlMDg0Iiwic2hvcnRjb2RlIjoid29vZG1hcnRfdGV4dF9ibG9jayIsImRhdGEiOnsidGFibGV0Ijp7fSwibW9iaWxlIjp7fX19" parallax_scroll="no" wd_hide_on_desktop="no" wd_hide_on_tablet="no" wd_hide_on_mobile="no"]

Key Features of Our Continent STL Models

  • High-resolution topography based on real elevation data
  • STL format — industry standard for 3D printing and CNC
  • Scalable models — resize without quality loss
  • Closed geometry suitable for manufacturing
  • Optimized for 3D printing, CNC milling, laser marking, and casting

These 3D printable continent maps are suitable for creating wall art, educational models, museum exhibits, gifts, and large-format terrain installations.

[/woodmart_text_block][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/2"][woodmart_text_block woodmart_css_id="69706c43d4857" woodmart_inline="no" responsive_spacing="eyJwYXJhbV90eXBlIjoid29vZG1hcnRfcmVzcG9uc2l2ZV9zcGFjaW5nIiwic2VsZWN0b3JfaWQiOiI2OTcwNmM0M2Q0ODU3Iiwic2hvcnRjb2RlIjoid29vZG1hcnRfdGV4dF9ibG9jayIsImRhdGEiOnsidGFibGV0Ijp7fSwibW9iaWxlIjp7fX19" parallax_scroll="no" wd_hide_on_desktop="no" wd_hide_on_tablet="no" wd_hide_on_mobile="no"]

Use Cases

  • 3D printed geographic maps
  • CNC-carved wooden or metal maps
  • Educational tools for schools and universities
  • Interior and wall decor
  • Prototyping and concept visualization
  • Creative and artistic terrain projects
[/woodmart_text_block][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row][vc_column][woodmart_text_block woodmart_css_id="69706c5a22904" woodmart_inline="no" responsive_spacing="eyJwYXJhbV90eXBlIjoid29vZG1hcnRfcmVzcG9uc2l2ZV9zcGFjaW5nIiwic2VsZWN0b3JfaWQiOiI2OTcwNmM1YTIyOTA0Iiwic2hvcnRjb2RlIjoid29vZG1hcnRfdGV4dF9ibG9jayIsImRhdGEiOnsidGFibGV0Ijp7fSwibW9iaWxlIjp7fX19" parallax_scroll="no" wd_hide_on_desktop="no" wd_hide_on_tablet="no" wd_hide_on_mobile="no"]

Customization & Support

All continent STL models can be easily modified: adjust scale, height exaggeration, base thickness, or combine multiple continents into a single composition. Custom sizes, projections, or resolutions are available upon request.

Explore the Continents 3D STL Models category and download professional-grade terrain files for your next 3D printing or CNC project.

[/woodmart_text_block][/vc_column][/vc_row]
